run_blackify_single_file: run blackify on a single markdown file to format all embedded Python code blocks
run_blackify_check_only: run blackify in check-only mode on a markdown file to verify code formatting without changes
run_format_all_files: run format_all_files to format Python code blocks in all markdown files under the chapters directory
run_format_all_check_only: run format_all_files in check-only mode to verify all markdown code blocks are properly formatted
run_cli_code_formatter: run the code formatter CLI with the --check_only flag to validate formatting across all files
